en: A vintage black and white postcard depicting a European town square with several historic buildings. The most prominent buildings are labeled 'HOTEL GOLDENER LÖWE' and 'Hotel Deutsches Haus'. There are people walking and standing in the square, and a few visible shop signs. The architectural style suggests Central Europe, possibly Germany, with classic sloped roofs and dormer windows. The text at the bottom is written in an old-fashioned German script.
